svg.title: Metformin vs placebo: seven randomized trials
svg.desc: Metformin vs placebo: seven randomized trials. Diabetes prevention (DPP), 2002, 3234 people: Main goal met; lifestyle did better. Breast cancer (MA.32), 2022, 3649 people: Main goal missed. Strength training, 65+ (MASTERS), 2019, 94 people: Less muscle gain than placebo. Frail, mean age 80 (MET-PREVENT), 2025, 72 people: Main goal missed; poorly tolerated. Obese 65+ with lifestyle (DEMFOS), 2026, 114 people: No added benefit. HIV, epigenetic age (METFORAGING), 2026, 40 people: Main goal missed. Prediabetes, frailty (preprint), 2026, 145 people: Mixed; not peer reviewed.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
